name: vault_contents
summary: What each Ingot Vault stores, read from its own store to 1e-6: ingots as grams of reagent, ores and ices as counts; plus every Remote Vault's link. Read only.

help.text: Returns {vaults [{vault, position, on_off, powered, stock [{kind (ingot or ore), prefab_name (the item a vend makes), display_name, reagent, max_stack, quantity}], pending_vends}], remote_vaults [{remote, vault_id, connection (None, NoVaultDetected, MultipleVaultsDetected, VaultPoweredOff)}], count}. pending_vends: vends taken off the store and not yet made into the export slot.

vault_id.description: One Ingot Vault or Remote Vault; default every vault.
